description: Skips a person's campaign messages, as Skip on the roster does: scope 'all' (default) ends their remaining messages, 'step' skips one waiting step (step is its 0-based index; leave it out for the next waiting one). Nothing is sent; the person is skipped, not removed from the audience. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: skip_campaign_recipient
title: Skip a person's campaign messages
